keeper-ld-voetenwerk-lange-duik.naam: Footwork and then a long low dive
keeper-ld-voetenwerk-lange-duik.uitleg: The keeper shuffles across to the disc cone by the post and comes back to the middle with crossover steps. As they come back, the coach throws a low ball to the far corner: the keeper takes off and makes a long, low dive.
keeper-ld-voetenwerk-lange-duik.organisatie: Goal, two disc cones just in front of the posts. Coach at 8 m. Start the other way after each ball.
coachpunten: Keep watching the ball (coach) during the footwork
Take off from the leg on the ball side, the other leg swings through
Long dive: low and flat, don't jump up first

makkelijker: Get set first, then the ball
moeilijker: The ball comes at a random moment during the footwork
Ground ball struck hard
Straight after the dive, a second ball to the other corner

keeper-ld-over-de-horde.uitleg: There is a low hurdle on either side of the keeper. The coach throws the ball just beyond the hurdle. The keeper dives over the hurdle to the ball: that teaches them to dive forwards and along the ground rather than falling backwards.
keeper-ld-over-de-horde.organisatie: Keeper in goal, a 30 cm hurdle 1 m to their left and right. Coach at 7 m. Alternate left and right.
coachpunten: Take off and go diagonally forwards over the hurdle, don't fall beside it
Arms first: your hands get to the ball first
Land on your side, beyond the hurdle, and secure the ball

makkelijker: A stick or disc cones instead of a hurdle
moeilijker: Higher hurdle (high diving)
From footwork between the hurdles
The coach kicks the ball
After the dive, get up, back over the hurdle and a ball on the other side

keeper-ld-na-een-draai.uitleg: The keeper stands with their back to the coach. When the coach shouts 'turn', they turn round while the coach is already throwing the ball. The keeper has to pick up the ball quickly, choose the right side and dive low.
keeper-ld-na-een-draai.organisatie: Keeper 2 m in front of goal with their back to the pitch, coach at 7 m. The coach shouts and throws at the same time, alternating left and right.
coachpunten: Turn on the balls of your feet and land straight in the ready position
Find the ball with your eyes first, then move
Don't over-rotate: shoulders square to the ball

makkelijker: Only throw once the keeper has turned
The coach also says which side
moeilijker: The keeper starts lying on their front and springs up
Ball kicked hard
Two servers: only the one who shouts throws

keeper-ld-twee-aangevers.uitleg: Two keepers serve from the left and right, each with a ball. First the left one throws a low ball, then the right one: the keeper in goal dives to both sides, gets up quickly and rolls the ball back. Then rotate: the keeper in goal becomes a server, the server on the right goes in goal.
keeper-ld-twee-aangevers.organisatie: Goal, servers 8 m in front of goal, 7 m apart. Rotate after 4–6 balls.
coachpunten: Up quickly after the first dive: secure the ball first, then get up
Reposition between the server and the centre of the goal
Dive forwards to the ball so it doesn't get behind you

makkelijker: More time between the two balls
moeilijker: The second ball comes while the keeper is still down (get up and dive)
The servers kick the ball
The servers decide who throws

keeper-cv-ladder-vangen-duiken.naam: Ladder, chest-height ball and low dive
keeper-cv-ladder-vangen-duiken.uitleg: The keeper runs through the ladder with quick steps, moves backwards into goal and catches a chest-height ball. Ball back to the coach, and straight after comes a low ball into the corner which they dive for.
keeper-cv-ladder-vangen-duiken.organisatie: 4 m ladder at an angle in front of goal. Coach at 10 m with two balls. After the set, back to the start of the ladder; alternate the low ball left and right.
coachpunten: After the ladder, move back quickly, facing the pitch
Chest-height ball: elbows together, trap the ball
Back in the ready position straight after the throw for the low ball

makkelijker: No ladder: start with quick feet on the spot
Roll the low ball instead of shooting
moeilijker: Two feet per square in the ladder
The low ball comes while the keeper is throwing back the first ball
Then one more high ball into the other corner

keeper-cv-circuit-twee-stations.naam: Goalkeeper circuit: ladder, hurdles and diving
keeper-cv-circuit-twee-stations.uitleg: Two stations at the same time. Keeper 2 does footwork through the ladder and over the hurdles, while keeper 1 in goal faces a low and a high ball from the coach. Then they swap stations.
keeper-cv-circuit-twee-stations.organisatie: Station 1 beside the goal: 4 m ladder and three hurdles. Station 2: goal with the coach at 9 m. Each keeper does each station twice, then rest.
coachpunten: Station 1: quick and precise, even when you get tired
Station 2: up quickly after the low dive and ready for the high ball
Swap without walking: the circuit keeps going

moeilijker: A third station with a reaction ball
Add a cross at station 2
Time it: who is fastest through station 1?

keeper-sp-duik-op-de-bal.uitleg: Two young keepers kneel facing each other. The coach rolls a ball between them. Whoever gets hold of the ball first (diving allowed) wins a point. A fun game to teach the youngest keepers to dive without being afraid.
keeper-sp-duik-op-de-bal.organisatie: Keepers kneeling 8 m apart, coach at the side 4 m from the line between them. Roll the ball a bit closer to one or the other each time. For U7–U11; on soft grass or a mat.
coachpunten: Hands to the ball first, head behind your arms
Land on your side, not on your stomach
Secure the ball: it's only yours once you've got hold of it

makkelijker: On a mat or soft grass
moeilijker: From a crouch or standing
The coach throws the ball (with a bounce)
Only start on a shout

keeper-ld-ladder-dubbele-duik.naam: Sideways ladder and a double dive
keeper-ld-ladder-dubbele-duik.uitleg: The keeper goes sideways through an agility ladder in front of goal, back into goal, and dives to a low ball the coach throws to their left. Get up, and straight away a high ball from keeper 2 on the right. Then the keepers swap.
keeper-ld-ladder-dubbele-duik.organisatie: Agility ladder across the front of goal at 4.5 m. Coach with balls at 10 m to the left of goal, keeper 2 with balls at 10 m to the right. At least 2 keepers.
coachpunten: Ladder: small quick steps, shoulders towards the pitch
Back in goal, get set first, then the ball
Low dive diagonally forwards; high dive: take off from the leg on the ball side

moeilijker: Ladder with two feet per square (in-in-out-out)
The coach and keeper 2 choose the order

keeper-ld-kniezit-hurkzit-stand.uitleg: Progressive low diving from three starting positions: first kneeling, then crouching and finally standing. Each set: a low ball to one side (dive and catch), get up, roll the ball back, sprint round the cone and back to goal, and straight away a second low ball to the other side.
keeper-ld-kniezit-hurkzit-stand.organisatie: Keeper in the middle of the goal, 1.7 m in front of the goal line. Cone 5 m in front of goal, slightly to the left. Coach with balls at 9 m. A few of each position, then the next.
coachpunten: Land on your side, not on your stomach or elbows
Hands to the ball first: one hand behind, one on top
After the sprint, get set in the ready position first, then the second ball

moeilijker: Ball further from the keeper
Second ball at mid-height
Cone further away: less time to get into position

keeper-ld-drie-pionnen-korte-hoek.naam: Three cones and the near post
keeper-ld-drie-pionnen-korte-hoek.uitleg: Keeper and coach are both at an angle to the goal. The keeper stands between a cone and the post; beside them are three cones, on the side away from the post. They touch cone 1 and dive straight back into the near corner (the coach chooses low or high). Get up, ball back, then touch cone 2 and dive, and finally cone 3. The further the cone, the longer the dive.
keeper-ld-drie-pionnen-korte-hoek.organisatie: Three cones 0.9 m apart in a line beside the keeper, 0.7 m in front of their line of movement; the first 1 m from the post. Coach at an angle at 8–9 m, on the near-post side.
coachpunten: After touching the cone, get set (ready position) first, then dive
Take off from the leg on the post side, dive diagonally forwards
The near post comes first: nothing between you and the post

moeilijker: Cones further apart
The coach calls the cone: the keeper has to touch that one
Low and high mixed without warning

keeper-ld-vier-laag-vier-hoog.uitleg: First four low balls, alternating left and right: dive, catch and play the ball straight back to the coach from the ground, then get up and back to the middle. Then catch and return four balls at head height.
keeper-ld-vier-laag-vier-hoog.organisatie: Keeper in the middle of the goal, 1.6 m off the line. Coach with balls at 8–9 m.
coachpunten: Low dive: get low first, then fall sideways with your hands to the ball
Play it back from the ground: calm and accurate, only then get up
Head height: W grip, hold the ball for a moment

moeilijker: Low balls further from the keeper
The coach picks the side at the last moment
High balls beside the head

keeper-ld-drie-duiken-aangevers.uitleg: Three servers, three dives straight after each other: first a low ball to the left, then a mid-height ball to the right and finally a high ball to the right. After each dive, get straight up and back to the middle for the next. Then the keeper swaps with a server.
keeper-ld-drie-duiken-aangevers.organisatie: Servers at 8–9 m: angled on the left (keeper), centre (coach) and angled on the right (keeper), each with a ball.
coachpunten: Get up quickly through your knees, straight back into the ready position
Mid-height and high: take off from the leg on the ball side
Hands behind the ball, pull it in to secure it as you land

moeilijker: Mixed order
Balls further from the keeper
After the high dive, one more low ball to the left

keeper-ld-zigzag-voor-achteruit.uitleg: Three poles stand one behind the other in front of goal. The keeper zigzags forwards through them and at the end gets a mid-height ball to the left: dive and catch. Get up, ball back, then zigzag backwards to the goal, facing the pitch. There a ball comes to the right: dive again.
keeper-ld-zigzag-voor-achteruit.organisatie: Three poles 1.4 m apart one behind the other, starting 3 m in front of goal. Coach with balls at 13 m.
coachpunten: Small quick steps round the poles, shoulders towards the coach
Backwards: weight on the balls of your feet, don't lean back
Mid-height: take off and stretch your body towards the ball

moeilijker: Poles closer together
The coach picks the side at the last moment
High ball for the second dive

keeper-ld-skip-duik-tussen-palen.naam: Skip, low dive and between the poles
keeper-ld-skip-duik-tussen-palen.uitleg: The keeper moves sideways along a row of poles with short skipping steps. At the end they get a low ball: dive and catch. Get up, ball back, then forwards between two poles, where they catch a ball at head height.
keeper-ld-skip-duik-tussen-palen.organisatie: Three poles in a row, 1.6 m apart, 3.4 m in front of goal. Coach with balls at 10 m.
coachpunten: Sideways on the balls of your feet, don't cross
Stay low after the last pole: the ball comes straight away
Between the poles: straight line, be set for the ball

moeilijker: Low ball further away
Ball between the poles at mid-height beside the body
Two rounds without a break

keeper-ld-paal-duik-andere-kant.naam: Sideways to the post, dive to the other side
keeper-ld-paal-duik-andere-kant.uitleg: The keeper moves sideways to the left post and then gets a low ball to the right: dive, catch, get up and back to the middle going backwards. Then the mirror image: sideways to the right post and dive to the left. That's one round; do two.
keeper-ld-paal-duik-andere-kant.organisatie: Keeper in the middle of the goal, 1.4 m off the line. Coach with balls at 9 m.
coachpunten: At the post: stop and get set before the ball comes
Take off from the leg on the diving side, dive diagonally forwards
Back going backwards, facing the pitch

makkelijker: Not as far to the post
moeilijker: Mid-height ball
The coach throws while the keeper is still moving
Three rounds in a row

keeper-ld-rondje-hoedje.uitleg: The keeper does a quick loop round a disc cone just in front of them and immediately gets a low ball: dive and catch. Get up, back and again. On the second go the ball comes with a bounce.
keeper-ld-rondje-hoedje.organisatie: Disc cone 1 m in front of the keeper, 3 m in front of goal. Coach with balls at 8 m.
coachpunten: Small, quick loop on the balls of your feet
After the loop, get set in the ready position first
Bouncing ball: don't dive too early, wait for it to come up

makkelijker: Walk the loop, then a pause
moeilijker: Two loops
The coach throws during the loop
Balls further away
